title: ListRunningQueriesResponse
description: Response containing every active Oracle query visible to one tenant.

queries.description: Active request summaries in deterministic request-ID order.

RequestId.description: Request correlation ID; required to be a UUID v7.

RunningQueryLifecycleState.description:
The current non-terminal lifecycle state of an admitted Oracle query.

The state is projected by live controls only; completed queries are removed from the in-memory registry and are not durable query jobs.

oneOf.description: Admission completed and execution has not emitted progress yet.
The selected participant cut is executing.
A caller requested cancellation and owners are draining the cut.

RunningQueryProgress.description: Aggregate progress for one request-ID-keyed Oracle query.

completed_participants.description: Number of selected participants that have reported completion.

total_participants.description: Exact number of participants frozen into the immutable cut.

RunningQuerySummary.description:
Public summary for one active Oracle query.

This contract deliberately excludes SQL text, parameters, Arrow batches, and result rows. A summary is tenant-scoped by the serving boundary.

cancellation_requested.description: Whether cancellation has been requested for this request identity.

progress.description: Aggregate progress over the immutable participant cut.

request_id.description: Stable request identity used by live controls.
